drafted_from: tools/motion-film-template/tool-rows.json (tool:write-the-icon-shapes-a-motion-film-uses), do-work/write-icon-shapes.mjs and the test "icon shapes are read from lucide modules" in test/motion-film-template.test.mjs; the answers were produced by running the script on that test's made-up icons folder
start_here: Say to your AI: "Write the check and dot icon shapes my film uses from lucide-react into the film's assets/js/icons.js, and tell me which icons were written."
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it reads the icon files of lucide-react on your computer and writes one icons file for the film.
instructions: 1. Get lucide-react (npm pack lucide-react, then unpack it) or use one already installed, and find its dist/esm/icons folder.

2. Say which icons the film shows. The AI writes a request file {icons_dir, names, out} (out is the film's assets/js/icons.js; leave it out to get the file's text back instead) and runs node trillion-workshop/tools/motion-film-template/do-work/write-icon-shapes.mjs < request.json.

3. Read the last line: {"result": {"names", "bytes", "out"}} when it wrote the file, {"result": {"names", "bytes", "text"}} when out was left out, or {"error": ...} naming an icon the folder does not hold.
4. Load assets/js/icons.js in the film's page; window.ICONS[name] is a list of [tag, attributes] shapes for a 24x24 viewBox.

worked_examples.title: Two icons written into the film's icons file
worked_examples.ask: Write the check and dot icon shapes my film uses from lucide-react into the film's icons file.
worked_examples.given: From the test "icon shapes are read from lucide modules" in test/motion-film-template.test.mjs and do-work/write-icon-shapes.mjs, run on this computer with that test's made-up icons folder (icons/check.mjs holds one path "M20 6 9 17l-5-5", icons/dot.mjs holds a circle at 12,12 radius 1 and a path "M1 1"). The request file holds {"icons_dir": "icons", "names": ["check", "dot"], "out": "icons.js"}. The AI runs: node trillion-workshop/tools/motion-film-template/do-work/write-icon-shapes.mjs < request.json
worked_examples.hands_back: {"result":{"names":["check","dot"],"bytes":215,"out":"icons.js"}} is the last line. icons.js holds two lines: "// generated by tools/motion-film-template write-icon-shapes from lucide-react (ISC)" and window.ICONS={"check":[["path",{"d":"M20 6 9 17l-5-5"}]],"dot":[["circle",{"cx":"12","cy":"12","r":"1"}],["path",{"d":"M1 1"}]]}; with the React key dropped from every shape. Asking for a name the folder lacks, such as "nope", answers {"error":"no icon named nope in <icons_dir>"}.
